purpose: Paperclip hermes_local MiniMax M3 rollout verdict. Records the ROLLOUT / ROLLBACK_DECLARED / PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED decision for the Paperclip adapter flip from xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro to minimax/MiniMax-M3 on a bounded test agent. In the auto-mode execution lane, T04 cannot execute live VPS mutation (LFP-LF-02 + S02 H-INCONCLUSIVE + T02/T03 PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED), so this verdict is honest PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED. Live operator session will promote it to ROLLOUT or ROLLBACK_DECLARED after a clean Paperclip hermes_local session is observed.
rollout_verdict_rationale: T04 in the auto-mode execution lane can produce the rollout CONTRACT (decision rule, pre-conditions for ROLLOUT, pre-conditions for ROLLBACK_DECLARED, xiaomi fallback retention plan, full-fleet rollout gate) but cannot OBSERVE a live Paperclip hermes_local session on the bounded test agent through minimax-m3. The rollout verdict therefore remains PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED until an operator-confirmed live Paperclip session meets the ROLLOUT pre-conditions, OR until any failure mode meets the ROLLBACK_DECLARED pre-conditions. Producing a fake 'ROLLOUT' verdict here would constitute evidence laundering — instead, T04 records the decision rule and the pre-conditions so the live executor can apply them deterministically post-execution.

rollout_decision_rule.policy: Deterministic rule that the live executor MUST apply after observing the Paperclip hermes_local session. All four ROLLOUT pre-conditions must hold (logical AND) for ROLLOUT. Any single ROLLBACK_DECLARED pre-condition triggers ROLLBACK_DECLARED. Anything else (e.g., prerequisite not met, deferred for fresh readback) leaves the verdict at PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED.

rollout_pre_conditions.policy: All four pre-conditions MUST hold for the rollout verdict to be promoted from PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED to ROLLOUT. Any missing condition leaves the verdict at PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED.

Full xiaomi deprecation is a separate decision gated by S05 close-out and R019 validation contract revision; T04 only documents the fallback retention shape.

R019 validation contract is updated to reflect canonical provider/model/endpoint-class, mandatory secret_ref, clean-session proof, schema-valid BOS output, and prohibition on Xiaomi endpoint reuse.

full_fleet_rollout_gate.policy: Full-fleet rollout (flipping ALL Paperclip agents from xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro to minimax/MiniMax-M3) is OUT OF SCOPE for T04 / S05. T04 only flips ONE bounded test agent. Full-fleet rollout requires a separate decision slice and is gated by the following pre-conditions (all must hold before the next slice is opened).

inherited_constraints.summary: Prefer Paperclip HTTP/admin routes; never patch Paperclip core source.
Live mutation requires explicit authenticated operator confirmation with PAPERCLIP_COMPANY_ID_OVERRIDE=allow and visible target company.
Forbidden commands (docker compose down -v, prune, rm, volume rm) unless explicitly approved for destructive recovery.
VPS forensics verdict is H-INCONCLUSIVE; no destructive recovery is approved; only safe-restart command allowed.
Safe restart command MUST be the one in paperclip-runtime.lock.json safe_restart_command and nothing else.
Stale ID ledger from R3 must not appear as canonical company_id in any Hermes-driven mutation.
